name: cascader
title: Cascader
description: A single select for hierarchical data: the trigger opens a searchable list, and picking a branch replaces the list with its children while a breadcrumb shows the path.
use: The options form a hierarchy and a plain flat select would lose the parent context.
avoid: Deep trees take several clicks, and long chains crowd the trigger even with a segment cap.
a11y: Full combobox semantics, labelled lists and a live status region; the panel has no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim outlined trigger reading Select an attribute with a chevron sits on black. Open, a rounded dark panel shows a search field, rows with small icons, counts and chevrons, and a breadcrumb above the nested list.
behaves: Clicking the trigger drops the panel open; typing filters the current level, and selecting a branch with a chevron drills into its children while a back arrow and breadcrumb track the path. Choosing a leaf writes the full path into the trigger.
customise: Pass a nested items tree, value and change handlers; single or multiple mode, search scope, async loading and virtualisation are all props.
weight: moderate: A headless combobox with optional virtualisation and async loading; light for small trees.
demo: Attribute names like Record ID, Person, Company, Workspaces and Next due task.
polishWhy: Dense but tidy drill-down menu with a clear breadcrumb and search.
